name: Petty Crook Climb
hook: Steal loose change and rusty mopeds before the Vice PD busts your hustle
tagline: Two broke stick-up rookies scrounge convenience store registers while eyeing luxury yachts across Vice City. Cash out in time to peel out in a smoking sedan with a trunk full of rolls of quarters. Crash and an undercover cruiser clips your getaway bicycle into a display rack of cheap flip-flops.
